title: Wire the executable cross-field constraints into mdatron patterns and schema if/then (mdatron #73 assessment)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: WIRED (commit f1b6809e). Directive classification, recorded: increment entry, absorbable — mdatron's #73 assessment enables the executable subset of the declared cross-field constraints today; scope read as the specific wire-now instruction. LANDED: (1) .mdatron/patterns/registry-integrity.yaml (mirrored into the vsdd-core bundle as patterns::REGISTRY_INTEGRITY) — manifest pairs_with resolution VSDD-E0210, referenced_by resolution VSDD-E0211, statusline recovery-action registration against the composition vocabulary VSDD-E0212; nested every/some over self plus one key() over the composition artifact, the cross-references.yaml shape as mdatron predicted. (2) The stage-prefix rule as eleven if/then branches in the composition schema pair (mdatron's Layer-1 advice); composition-scope-and-actions bumps to 0.2.0 under the pair rule. (3) Schema descriptions now distinguish WIRED from DECLARED constraints. PROVEN both directions pre-commit: verify clean honest; broken pairs_with fires E0210; stripped prefix fires E0050 naming the pattern and the path. DEFERRAL WATCH, standing on this issue: uniqueness checks await mdatron's distinct primitive; regex-validity of branch-grammar patterns awaits new capability — retest when mdatron announces either. NOTE for the estate: these action-time checks now overlap the round-1 code suite's manifest_cross_references_resolve test — complementary by design (pre-commit catches authoring, the suite catches load-path regressions); recorded so the overlap reads as intent. Suite green (56/56), verify clean at pre-commit. Closing.
